name: Hermes Agent v0.22.2
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.2

**Release Date:** October 15, 2026

v0.22.1 was built from the wrong commit. It shipped unreleased gateway work, and the Microsoft Store app could stick on "Connecting." 0.22.2 is the release 0.22.1 was meant to be.

> **Known issue:** Sessions that ran under the 0.22.1 gateway can't be deleted in 0.22.2.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## Highlights

- **The gateway starts after a reboot again.** After a restart, Linux can hand an early PID to an unrelated process, and the gateway could mistake it for a running gateway, so a supervised gateway (systemd, launchd, Docker) refused to start. Hermes now records the boot it started in, and when it can't tell, it asks the host lock, which only a live gateway holds. ([#138594](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138594), fixes [#133744](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/issues/133744))
- **Long local-model turns survive on laptops.** Local requests always stream with prompt-reading progress (shown in the status line), stall timers skip time the machine was asleep, a recovered local server gets another try instead of a breaker that failed every later message, and compression no longer times out while the server is still reading a long conversation. On Windows unified-memory machines, model launch and the prompt cache are sized to free memory. ([#138560](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138560))

Below is everything in the 0.22 release line since v0.22.0: the fixes 0.22.1 was meant to ship, plus the two above. Work that is only on `main` ships with v0.23.0.

# HyperFrames v0.8.159

Released on 2026-10-14.

`check` and `snapshot` now work in sandboxes that refuse to listen on localhost. `snapshot --keep` lets you redo one still without losing the others.

## Features

- **CLI:** `snapshot --keep` redoes one still and leaves the others ([c0636d017f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c0636d017f68073522ab8eeb6cc24a2d3993b656), [#5605](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5605)). It adds to the output folder instead of clearing it and names each still for its time, such as `at-1.5s.png`.

## Fixes

- **Core:** A render's first frame shows each scene's starting state ([8c00ebad80c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c00ebad80c634f607e3a5283f8a0aa73e35f1dd), [#5614](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5614)).
- **Core:** A hidden scene's contents stay hidden when a child is set visible ([24a9b781715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/24a9b781715d0c59f06e4540831529d99c63ae75), [#5619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5619)). Before, a nested scene's card could paint before its host started. The `static-volume-future-set` regression baseline changes for this reason.
- **CLI:** `check` and `snapshot` run where a sandbox refuses to listen on localhost ([71595dd8201](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/71595dd82012314f353d1237f50da0fad7639817), [#5618](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5618)).
- **CLI:** The GPU check uses the same pipe as the render, so a sandboxed `check` no longer waits 120 s ([6c89decb0dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c89decb0ddbac7c30a7dca6d947f945ebd58c0e), [#5622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5622)).
- **CLI:** A long video conversion in `init` never stalls on ffmpeg's own log ([b14a4564716](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b14a45647166e60e2e51dc018ccb1bb7331003a2), [#5616](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5616)).

## Internal

- **Core:** The `var()` font fallback test uses an offline fetch stub instead of Google Fonts ([8f0bcadcd32](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8f0bcadcd32893d3ad5231f33b210c410096281f), [#5623](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5623)).
- A stalled history fetch in change detection is retried instead of failing the run ([cd87cf11106](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd87cf11106985c6222723f5b391723882691d6c), [#5615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5615)).

name: v0.8.158
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.158

Released on 2026-10-14.

`hyperframes init --keep-original` brings a clip into a project as it is, without converting it. Storyboards are now one board of stills, and `check` no longer fails on a busy Windows machine.

## Features

- **CLI:** `init --keep-original` copies a clip as it is, without transcoding ([d65eefad5ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d65eefad5ed351e9d36d2caeb6049878be0aba85), [#5612](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5612)).
- **Skills:** Storyboards are a board of stills with one page format ([6f90ca15a7f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6f90ca15a7fc937d9d6cf3ec289f2a26eca3724f), [#5599](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5599)). Agents pose each shot, snapshot it, and lay the stills out on one page, `boards/storyboard.html`, before animating.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Capture keeps fonts a page declares in its own style block ([4957bf6939a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4957bf6939a34f659070e04b8c355b35e8be0782), [#5609](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5609)).
- **CLI:** A killed browser on a busy Windows machine no longer fails `check` ([fe29f157f94](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fe29f157f940c9e07768e25089fb5c4c404ad98d), [#5607](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5607)). Windows reports the process gone at once but its exit seconds later, and `check` used to stop on that gap.

## Internal

- **Engine:** The warm extraction cache test checks ffmpeg did not run, not the clock ([14e2ccf3bb0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/14e2ccf3bb0e93a2b0226ff665bee36b8033f4a2), [#5613](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5613)).
- **Engine:** Audio effect tests that start Chrome get the same time as the others ([7744692a464](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7744692a464aa740c893251478f383f46148c1ee), [#5608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5608)).

name: v1.14.2 - Extension metadata, faster completion
body:
## What's New in v1.14.2

This release lets you keep your own metadata on a change, makes Tab completion faster, and closes gaps where archive and verify could lose or miss content.

### New

- **Extension keys in `.openspec.yaml`** - Top-level keys starting with a lowercase `x-` (for example `x-goal: G-12` or `x-jiraKey`) are yours for tracker ids, owners, or other tool data. OpenSpec ignores them, so `openspec validate --strict` passes on a change that carries them. Any other unrecognized key is still reported.

### Improved

- **Faster Tab completion** - Shell completion now loads 48 modules instead of 344 when completing changes or specs, and no longer records usage, so a Tab press never waits on telemetry.
- **Warnings for text archive drops** - `openspec validate` and `openspec archive` now warn when a delta spec holds text that archive does not carry into the main spec, such as an extra `## ` section or prose before the first requirement. Like other warnings, these fail `openspec validate --strict`.
- **Verify checks removed requirements properly** - `/opsx:verify` reads a REMOVED requirement's original text from the main spec before searching the code, and reports the entry as not verified when that text cannot be recovered, instead of passing it.

### Fixed

- **Archive with symlinked directories** - `openspec archive` accepts `openspec/`, `openspec/changes`, or `openspec/specs` as a symlink, for example to a shared docs repository.
- **Explore with custom schemas** - Explore no longer offers to create default-schema files such as `design.md` under a schema that does not define them.
- **Update with glob artifacts** - The update workflow no longer refuses to create a new file under a partly written glob artifact.
- **Deeply nested brace patterns** - An artifact `generates` or `apply.tracks` pattern nesting braces more than 16 levels deep is rejected with a clear error instead of risking a crash.

## New Contributors

* @gliptak made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/981
* @myspec-dev1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2035
* @Khunjua made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2081
* @PiPlusTheta made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2094
* @gkinter made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2063

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v1.14.1...v1.14.2

name: v18.11.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Breaking Changes

- Removed `ApprovalDetailsOptions`; `formatApprovalDetails` takes only `args` again, since the compact approval prompt no longer shows tool details ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Added

- `AgentTool.delegationGuidance`: instructions a same-name extension replacement inherits in its description when it delegates to the native tool ([#15477](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15477) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))
- `CompactionPreparation.lastSummarizedEntryId` and `CompactionResult.providerReplayThroughEntryId`: a remote compaction that could only fit the history before the kept tail reports the last entry its native history covers; later entries replay normally ([#15712](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15712) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed native (OpenAI/Codex) remote compaction refusing or truncating sessions that fit the window: its preflight counted the JSON-escaped request, inflating quote-, backslash- and newline-heavy tool output such as disassembly by ~10–20%; it now counts text as the model reads it ([#15712](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15712) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed OpenAI V1/V2 remote compaction failing outright when the history, kept tail included, exceeds the context window (a large final response or tool output after the last check); it retries on the history before the kept tail ([#15712](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15712) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed fitted output caps overflowing the context window on strict hosts (llama.cpp-family) after turns with many parallel tool results; chat-template framing is now charged per locally counted message ([#15699](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15699))
- Fixed leaked DeepSeek DSML markup reaching saved history from reasoning blocks and from turns that also made a valid tool call ([#15485](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15485))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed parallel tool calls failing with "Tool call arguments are not valid JSON" on some OpenAI-compatible gateways, such as Gemini ([#15682](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15682) by [@Zzz141592653](https://github.com/Zzz141592653))
- Fixed Anthropic fallback-credit redemption losing its credit on errors that only mention `400` in their text, such as an overload message ([#15702](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15702) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed Anthropic fallback-credit redemption sending an extra `fallback-credit-2026-06-01` beta when the refused request used a newer one ([#15702](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15702) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed Anthropic fallback-credit redemptions failing when the refused turn included unsigned thinking ([#15702](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15702) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed turns ending without automatic retry when a gateway forwards Go's `use of closed network connection` transport error; it now retries like other dropped connections ([#15385](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15385))
- Fixed Codex SSE streams failing with an abort instead of retrying when the first event stalls ([#15542](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15542))
- Fixed Codex (ChatGPT subscription) requests with reasoning disabled, such as judges, titles, commit messages, and thinking `off`, leaving effort to the server default; they now send the lowest supported effort, or `none` where the model accepts it ([#15514](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15514))
- Fixed a Codex account whose token OpenAI rejects (401/403) continuing to show its last quota as healthy; `omp usage` now drops the stale report and `omp auth-gateway check` reports the credential as failing ([#15439](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15439))
- Fixed usage reports being served indefinitely while their provider keeps failing; the last successful report is now shown for at most 24 hours after it was fetched ([#15439](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15439))
- Fixed Responses requests 400ing (DeepSeek: "The `reasoning_text` in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API") after a tool call whose arguments were invalid JSON: the call is now replayed with its parse diagnostic instead of being dropped and leaving a trailing `[Orphan tool result]` note ([#15568](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15568))
- Fixed DeepSeek on OpenAI-compatible gateways leaving doubled-pipe DSML markup (`</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>`) in assistant text and reasoning ([#15485](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15485))
- Fixed sessions failing every request with `400 … thinking or redacted_thinking blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified` after a response fell back to another model mid-turn (e.g. through a gateway that opts into Anthropic server-side fallback); the turn now replays one model's reasoning, and a session already stuck on such a turn recovers by dropping that turn's reasoning and retrying ([#15654](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15654) by [@abilliontokens](https://github.com/abilliontokens))
- Fixed `omp auth-gateway`'s Anthropic `/v1/messages` stream misnumbering content blocks after a redacted reasoning block, which misrouted every later delta in index-addressed clients ([#15654](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15654) by [@abilliontokens](https://github.com/abilliontokens))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added `local/nemotron-streaming-en-0.6b` for local streaming English dictation ([#15759](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15759) by [@daaximus](https://github.com/daaximus)).
- Added SambaNova Cloud (`sambanova`) as a provider: `/login sambanova` with an API key, and the live `/v1/models` roster with its prices, reasoning models, and Gemma 4 image input ([#14986](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14986) by [@rjuez00](https://github.com/rjuez00))

### Changed

- OpenCode Go requests now go to the current `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` endpoint instead of the legacy `/zen/go` one ([#15722](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15722))

### Fixed

- Fixed OpenCode Go's `deepseek-flash` alias showing $0, unknown limits, and no reasoning instead of the V4.1 Flash rate card and capabilities ([#15357](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15357))
- Fixed OpenCode Go's Gemini 4 Argon Contributor failing with an unsupported protocol and thinking level; it now uses the native Gemini endpoint ([#15722](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15722))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added a microphone button beside Send in Tern: click to record, click Stop to finish, then review and submit the transcription yourself. Clicking while it says **Starting…** cancels a slow first model load ([#15759](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15759) by [@daaximus](https://github.com/daaximus)).
- Added local Nemotron streaming dictation: words appear while you speak, and the microphone waits for the recognizer to be ready before recording ([#15759](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15759) by [@daaximus](https://github.com/daaximus)).
- Added agent frontmatter `structured: true`: that agent's task spawns keep the `yield` tool and its `output` schema validation while `task.structured` is off ([#15717](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15717) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- The composer stays usable while a tool approval is pending: sending a message denies the call and steers the turn with it, so the agent knows why it was denied ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Session entries record which omp build wrote them, so a transcript shows whether a fix was live even in a session left open across an upgrade: the version, plus commit, branch, and uncommitted-diff hash when run from a source checkout, and `OMP_BUILD_LABEL` when set. `/session` lists the builds that wrote the session ([#15680](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15680) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- The in-composer tool approval prompt summarizes the command, path, or content to one row so the composer keeps its room; `Ctrl+O` shows them in full ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Background task guidance now lives in the Task tool description (and in same-name extension replacements that delegate to Task) instead of being repeated in every spawn acknowledgment ([#15477](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15477) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))
- The Auto-Promote Context and Retry Model Fallback settings now state that they are independent; turn off Retry Model Fallback (`retry.modelFallback`) to stop `retry.fallbackChains` model switches ([#15636](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15636))

### Fixed

- `tab.ariaSnapshot()` no longer prints the value of a password field; it shows one bullet per character, as `tab.observe()` and the screen do, so a typed or browser-autofilled password stays out of the model's context ([#15502](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15502) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed project discovery loading plugins, `SYSTEM.md`, rules, context files, and skills from a `.omp` at a shared temporary root (`/tmp`, `/var/tmp`, the temp dir) above an unanchored working directory, or, when `HOME` is overridden, from another account's `~/.omp` outside the working directory's git repository ([#15719](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15719) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed browser `tab.text()` and `tab.html()` (and the same calls on a frame) throwing when called without a selector; they now read the page body on Chrome, Tern and cmux ([#15599](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15599) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed skill-description compression re-sending the same smol-model requests every session for a skill whose compressed answer was rejected (over 12 words or 160 characters) or cut off at the token limit; that model is no longer asked again for that skill (a newly selected smol model is), and compressions still running at exit get up to 4 seconds to save ([#13291](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/13291), [#15720](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15720) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed the macOS `computer` tool keeping the display awake for the rest of the session after a native call hung; the call's timeout or closing the session now lets it sleep ([#15414](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15414) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed an agent definition whose `tools` value names no tool (`tools: ""`, a number, a list without strings) getting every default built-in tool; it now gets none, like `tools: []` ([#15718](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15718) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `page.waitForNetworkIdle` in a browser `run` timing out on a request an earlier `run` started ([#15495](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15495) by [@alnaggar-dev](https://github.com/alnaggar-dev) and [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a tab that a relay page opens over its own CDP session (`Target.createTarget`) landing in a separate Chrome window with `newWindow`, under an id omp could not attach to, activate or close; it now opens as a relay tab in that page's browser ([#15494](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15494) by [@alnaggar-dev](https://github.com/alnaggar-dev) and [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed an Anthropic refusal fallback redeeming its fallback credit with an outdated system prompt and tools after switching models; it now sends a fresh request ([#15702](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15702) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed OpenAI/Codex auto-compaction failing with "Remote compaction input exceeds the context window" after a turn's final response pushed history past the window; native compaction now compacts the history before the kept recent turns, which stay in context as-is ([#15712](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15712) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `omp commit`, `/git`, and other agent commits skipping the signature when Git's `commit.gpgsign` is enabled; they now sign with the configured key, and a signing failure leaves HEAD unchanged ([#14810](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14810))
- Fixed rejected `task` calls appearing successful to SDK hosts instead of reporting a tool error ([#15573](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15573))
- Fixed `read` claiming regenerated images were identical when their pixels changed at the same path ([#15668](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15668))
- Fixed SDK embedders leaking every disposed `AgentSession` that owned its MCP manager, so long-lived processes that create and dispose many sessions grew memory without bound ([#15386](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15386))
- Fixed retry model fallback stopping at a fallback model whose provider is outside a subagent's `task.agentAccountPools` pool; that model is now skipped and the next fallback model is tried ([#15423](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15423))
- Fixed the system prompt's `## MCP Server Instructions` section following MCP connection order, so a server connecting late or reconnecting no longer reorders it and rewrites the prompt cache; servers are now listed by name ([#15705](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15705))
- Fixed `read` reporting an HTTP 204 No Content response as a failed fetch; it now returns an empty successful read ([#15667](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15667))
- Fixed `/mcp reauth` failing with `Could not discover OAuth endpoints` when a server's 401 challenge is a bare `Bearer resource_metadata="…"`; the advertised protected-resource metadata URL is now used ([#15690](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15690))
- Fixed extension `agent_end` events reporting a background-job wait as a scheduled continuation; they now carry `awaitingAsyncWork: true` alongside `willContinue` ([#15348](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15348))
- Fixed auto-compaction waiting out provider retry delays longer than `retry.maxDelayMs` (e.g. a 16-hour `retry-after`); it now tries the next configured method or reports the failure ([#15311](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15311))
- Fixed `read skill://<name>` for a name no loaded skill owns hanging for the rest of the turn while an MCP server was still connecting or reconnecting; it now reports `Unknown skill` after at most 5 seconds ([#15648](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15648))
- Fixed `/new` ignoring "Start in Plan Mode" (`plan.defaultOnStartup`): the new session now starts in plan mode like the first one ([#15627](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15627))
- Fixed Cursor models' Read on an image file returning the file's raw bytes as text; Read now loads the image, and Cursor's text-only Read frame gets a short image note instead of the bytes ([#15630](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15630))
- Fixed Mermaid diagrams showing `<`, `>`, `&`, and `#quot;` literally inside labels instead of `<`, `>`, `&`, and `"` ([#15619](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15619))
- Fixed background job results already consumed by an eval `agent()` handle's `wait()` being re-injected as one `async-result` follow-up when the cell ran past the 5-minute job retention window ([#15625](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15625))
- Fixed `/tan` missing the parent's prompt cache: it advertised the parent's `xd://` tools as top-level tools and dropped `ask`, so its tool list no longer matched ([#15578](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15578))
- Fixed forks and reloaded sessions missing the prompt cache after a compaction in a session with `eval` history ([#15695](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15695))
- Fixed compiled-binary extensions importing `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui` subpaths such as `terminal-capabilities`, `chat/svg-figure` or `theme/index` loading a second copy from their own `node_modules` instead of sharing the host's terminal, theme and figure state ([#15659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15659))
- Fixed marketplace plugins that keep their version in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` never being reported by `omp plugin upgrade` or auto-updated; for plugins shipped inside the marketplace, `plugin.json`'s version now also takes precedence over the catalog entry's, as in Claude Code ([#15585](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15585))
- Fixed a steer (queued user or peer message) waiting behind a `bash` service's readiness wait (`name` + `ready`) for up to `ready.timeout`; the call now returns early with the service still starting, inspectable via `proc://<name>` ([#15653](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15653))
- Fixed `omp install`/`omp plugin install`, `upgrade`, `uninstall` and `doctor --fix` failing with `Executable not found in $PATH: "bun"` for npm and Git plugins on machines without Bun installed, such as standalone-binary installs ([#15480](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15480))
- Fixed `/plugins enable` and `/plugins disable` in the TUI not refreshing skills, commands, task agents and MCP servers until a reload, and rejecting npm plugins ([#15383](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15383))
- Fixed local memory injection and `learn` using the `Settings` directory instead of the session's project directory, so SDK hosts sharing one `Settings` across projects injected another project's lessons and never the project's consolidated summary; sharpshooter memory follows the session directory too ([#15375](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15375))
- Fixed ACP bash approvals ignoring `bash.patterns`, and an earlier "Always allow" letting critical commands such as `rm -rf /` run without a prompt ([#15473](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15473))
- Fixed hashline edits silently dropping the tail of a line that `read` or `grep` had cut at the column limit; such an edit is now refused until a `:raw` read shows the full line ([#15649](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15649))
- Fixed isolated tasks failing on linked worktrees with initialized recursive submodules and leaving updated submodule pins unreachable after cleanup ([#15457](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15457))
- Fixed `/tan` missing the parent's prompt cache by advertising `xd://` tools top-level and omitting `ask` ([#15578](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15578)).

name: Reasonix CLI v2.41.0
body:
CLI archives built from the Studio release [studio-v2.41.0](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.41.0).

This release adds side questions, keeping a long paste as a file, optional session-row buttons and a sandbox device allowlist, and fixes narrow-window layout, contrast, memory recall and remote-control compatibility.

## New

- Settings → Model preferences gains an independent naming model and per-role reasoning effort, so titles can use their own model and each role its own effort. Refs #11851.
- New side questions: ask a read-only question beside the main conversation; read-only tools, never in the main transcript, dropped on close. Refs #12927, #13128.
- Each class in the context details can be opened to its largest items (sizes and tool names only, never message text). Refs #13052, #13143.
- When an MCP server puts `ttlMs` on its tool list, the catalog is re-read once it runs out (clamped to 30 s to 1 h) instead of relying on change notices alone. Refs #13108.
- A skill's `allowed-tools` now also takes the open-standard spelling (space separated, like `Bash(git add:*) Read`); commas still work. Refs #13110.
- `reasonix doctor` now reports skill names and descriptions that depart from the Agent Skills spec (uppercase, hyphens, length, directory mismatch); such skills still load. Refs #13110.
- Settings → Appearance gains "Session row buttons": when on, hovering a sidebar session row shows Archive and Delete; off by default, both stay in the context menu. Refs #13132.
- When compaction rejects its candidate as too large, the message now splits it into fixed prefix, protected messages, summary and recent tail, not just "still above trigger". Refs #13148.
- The feedback dialog gains an "Ideas and discussion" link to GitHub Discussions for suggestions; bugs and errors still use Send. Refs #13141, #13155.
- New `[sandbox] allow_devices`: the Linux command sandbox hides host devices such as the GPU; a user-level allowlist binds them in. Off by default; project config cannot set it. Refs #13157.
- The long-paste chip gains "save as file": on click the text is stored as a file and the message carries only a pointer (lines, size, path, how to read it); never automatic. Refs #13148, #13162.
- In the terminal, a folded long paste can be kept as a file with Ctrl+G: the message carries a pointer, not the text; without the key it is sent whole as before. Refs #13148, #13166.

## Changed

- ACP tool-call updates now name the invoked tool. Refs #13114, #13130.
- On Linux, bubblewrap installed but unable to create a namespace (containers, hardened kernels) now gets its real cause and ways out, not "install it". Refs #13117, #13138, #13146.
- Compaction now refuses up front when the protected messages and recent tail already reach the trigger, naming what holds the size, instead of paying for a summary that cannot fit. Refs #13148.

## Fixed

- A recalled memory fact edited or deleted outside the session is re-read before the next recall (only the last hits are checked, no full scan). Refs #12948.
- Unreadable memory directories now report errors, keeping revision lists, restores, and recovery from treating permission or storage failures as missing data. Refs #12950.
- On Linux, a launch folder nobody picked and nothing was said in is no longer listed as a project, so deleting it does not bring it back on restart. Refs #13107, #13127.
- A requested file that does not exist is now said so in the side panel instead of opening a blank preview page. Refs #13125, #13133.
- With a wallpaper set, the sidebar footer no longer paints a whiter plate; the picture continues to the bottom. Refs #13129, #13131.
- On a phone browser too old for X25519 in WebCrypto, remote control now falls back to an audited software curve, loaded only then (about 24 KB), instead of asking for a newer browser. Refs #13140.
- When an older session cannot be opened after a restart, the error now says why: the file is gone, its folder is gone, or the system could not read the path (with its reason). Refs #13152, #13159.
- Narrow windows no longer overlap or squeeze: the tab bar wraps, settings labels keep their width, segmented controls stay in the sheet, and a few colours reach AA. Refs #13169.
- Narrow windows: activity step rows keep their duration and arrow, the meter rail's subagent chip keeps its count when it cannot fit, and config error paths wrap. Refs #13154, #13172.
- Fixed two contrast shortfalls: the intro "press any key to skip" hint and the +/− counts in the changed-files pill (both themes). Found by the audit at f8c262da0.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.41.0
body:
本版本新增辅助会话、按需保存长粘贴、会话行快捷按钮、沙盒设备白名单等功能，并修复窄窗口布局、对比度、记忆召回和远控兼容等一批问题。

## 新增

- 设置 → 模型偏好新增「命名模型」和按角色的推理强度：可以单独指定用哪个模型给会话起标题，并分别设置各角色的推理强度。关联 #11851 by @Guan0923。
- 新增「辅助会话」：在主对话旁边问一个只读的小问题，用只读工具回答，不写进主对话、不改文件，关闭即丢弃。关联 #12927 fixed in #13128、#13128。
- 上下文详情里每一类占用可以展开，看最大的几项（只显示大小和工具名，不含消息内容）。关联 #13052、#13143。
- MCP 服务器在工具列表响应里给出 `ttlMs` 时，工具目录会在到期后自动重读（限制在 30 秒到 1 小时之间），不再只靠变更通知。关联 #13108。
- 技能的 `allowed-tools` 现在也接受开放标准写法（空格分隔，如 `Bash(git add:*) Read`），原来的逗号分隔照常可用；括号内的分隔符属于同一条规则。关联 #13110。
- `reasonix doctor` 现在会提示技能的名称、描述不符合 Agent Skills 开放标准（大写、连字符、超长、与目录名不一致），这些技能仍会正常加载。关联 #13110。
- 设置 → 外观新增「会话行快捷按钮」：打开后，鼠标移到侧栏会话行上会显示「归档」「删除」按钮；默认关闭，两个操作仍在右键菜单里。关联 #13132。
- 压缩被拒时，提示现在列出候选内容的构成（固定前缀、被保护的消息、摘要、最近回合各占多少），不再只说「候选仍高于触发线」。关联 #13148。
- 反馈对话框新增「想法与讨论」入口，建议和想法可以发到 GitHub 讨论区，bug 和错误仍用发送。关联 #13141、#13155。
- 新增 `[sandbox] allow_devices`：Linux 命令沙盒默认看不到宿主的设备节点（如显卡），现在可在用户级配置里用 `/dev/nvidia*` 这类白名单放进去；默认关闭，项目配置不能开。关联 #13157。
- 撰写框里的长粘贴芯片新增「存为文件」：点了才把这段文字存成文件，消息里只带一段指针（行数、大小、路径、怎么读），原文不再随每个请求发送；不会自动存。关联 #13148、#13162。
- 终端界面里折叠的长粘贴可以按 Ctrl+G 存成文件：发送时只带一段指针，不再把原文送给模型；不按就和以前一样整段发送。关联 #13148、#13166。

## 变更

- ACP 的工具调用更新现在带上被调用的工具名。关联 #13114、#13130。
- Linux 上 bubblewrap 已安装却不能创建命名空间（容器、受限内核）时，提示不再说「请安装」，而是说明真实原因和出路。关联 #13117、#13138、#13146。
- 压缩前先预判：被保护的消息和最近回合本身就已超过触发线、摘要无论怎样都放不进去时，直接拒绝并说明构成，不再先花一次摘要调用。关联 #13148。

## 修复

- 会话里召回过的记忆在会话外被修改或删除后，下一次召回会读到新内容（只重查上次命中的几条，不全量扫描）。关联 #12948 fixed in #13147。
- 记忆目录因权限或存储故障无法读取时，现在明确报错，避免漏列历史版本、误报版本不存在，或根据不完整历史计算恢复版本号。关联 #12950 fixed in #13016 by @SivanCola。
- Linux 上启动时不再把没人选过、也没说过话的启动目录（主目录）列成项目，删掉它重启后不会再回来。关联 #13107 fixed in #13127、#13127。
- 要打开的文件不存在时，右侧面板现在明确提示「找不到该文件」，不再打开一片空白的预览页。关联 #13125、#13133。
- 设置壁纸后，侧栏底部（钱包与用量、发送反馈、账号）不再多出一块发白的底，壁纸一直延续到最下面。关联 #13129、#13131。
- 手机浏览器版本太旧、没有 X25519 加密时，远控现在改用经审计的软件实现继续连接（只在需要时才加载，约 24 KB），不再要求换浏览器。关联 #13140。
- 重启后点以前的会话打不开时，提示现在区分原因：会话文件已不在、会话所在目录不在、或系统读不了该路径（并带上系统给的原因），不再一律说「无法解析该会话路径」。关联 #13152、#13159。
- 窄窗口下界面不再重叠或被挤压：标签栏会换行，设置里的标签不再被压成一字一行，分段控件不再跑出面板，几处文字对比度提高到 AA。关联 #13169。
- 窄窗口下的排版修正：活动步骤行的耗时与箭头不再被挤出，计量栏的子代理芯片收起文字保留数字，配置错误框的路径改为换行。关联 #13154、#13172。
- 修复两处对比度不达 AA：开场页的「按任意键跳过」提示，和输入框上方「已更改文件」胶囊里的 +/− 数字（深浅两种主题）。整机审查于 f8c262da0。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@Guan0923、@SivanCola

---

---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: Open Design 0.25.0 — Steadier Ground
body:
### 🌟 Codename: *Steadier Ground*

🧭 **`5 PRs` · `2 contributors` · `4 days`** — **Open Design gets out of its own way.** Old workspace activity and noisy support evidence used to linger after you had moved on → 0.25.0 keeps the signal with the work that still matters. 🚀

## 🔥 Highlights

- 🗂️ **Recent projects follow the workspace you are actually in.** Switching catalogs used to leave an old project quietly polling in the background; now its stale activity steps aside, so the projects in front of you get the attention. (#8442) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- 🔎 **Automatic diagnostics keep the useful trail, not the noise.** When an AMR run fails, its runtime records can join the evidence; repeated delivery receipts no longer crowd out the failure you need to understand. (#8488, #8461) Thanks @Siri-Ray.
- 🔐 **Consent remains a real boundary on Windows.** Rotated logs stay on the correct side of the choice you made, so support evidence remains helpful without widening what you agreed to share. (#8487) Thanks @Siri-Ray.

name: v0.21.12
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.12

`0.21.12` is a patch release for the frozen range `v0.21.11..6937884f4d09a485d5b4f16498517bcd05384e06` (6 commits, 15 files, +998/−19).

## Highlights

- **Claim-bound completion evidence (#3797):** implementation tasks marked `requires_code_change: true` now require a report tied to the active task claim and a structured verification summary before completion. Existing clients must supply that evidence; tasks without the flag and transitions to `failed` retain their previous behavior.
- **More reliable HUD updates (#3786, #3791):** watcher repair children are bounded so hung reconciliation cannot block later repairs, and git branch labels are cached until HEAD, refs, or git config changes.
- **Dependency update (#3794):** update `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` from 1.32.0 to 1.32.1.

## Fixes and compatibility

- Implementation-task clients completing tasks marked `requires_code_change: true` must write claim-bound evidence under `.omx/evidence/` and include a structured verification summary and evidence marker. Non-code-change tasks and failed transitions do not require a report (#3797).
- No breaking CLI or package-layout changes are included. HUD test fixture isolation improvements are covered by #3788 and #3789.

## Validation evidence

Frozen candidate `6937884f4d09a485d5b4f16498517bcd05384e06` is green on dev CI. Local build, typecheck, and relevant test results are recorded in `docs/qa/release-readiness-0.21.12.md`.

Full readiness evidence: `docs/qa/release-readiness-0.21.12.md`.

name: v1.25.0-pre
body:
This week's release includes automatic unfolding of folded code when jumping to a location, applying inlay hint edits with a double-click, context compaction for external agents, and new Gemini 4 Argon and Amazon Bedrock models.

## Features

### AI

- Added the Gemini 4 Argon model (`gemini-4-argon`) to the Google AI provider. ([#65565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65565); thanks [LorenzoBiassio](https://github.com/LorenzoBiassio))
- Added GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Opus 5.5 to the Amazon Bedrock provider. ([#64201](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64201), [#64685](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64685); thanks [IbrahimKhan12](https://github.com/IbrahimKhan12) and [alexandergunnarson](https://github.com/alexandergunnarson))
- Enabled session notices and context compaction for external agents using ACP. ([#65414](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65414))

### Git

- Improved the branch picker to make clear that deleting a remote-tracking branch only removes the local ref, and removed the force delete option for remote-tracking branches, since it had no effect. ([#61793](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/61793); thanks [lld4n](https://github.com/lld4n))

### Languages

- Added support for applying inlay hint text edits by double-clicking a hint, or by running `editor: accept inlay hint` with the cursor at the hint. ([#64789](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64789))

### Remote Development

- Improved SSH remote connection time by detecting the remote shell, platform, and OS version in one command instead of three, which helps most when connecting from Windows. ([#65065](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65065); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii))

### Other

- Added automatic unfolding of folded sections when jumping to a location via go to line, go to definition/declaration/implementation/type definition, symbol navigation, the outline and project symbol pickers, multibuffer location results, and navigation history. ([#65217](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65217); thanks [henne90gen](https://github.com/henne90gen))
- Added an "Open SVG Preview" option to the Project Panel's context menu for SVG files. ([#65539](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65539); thanks [skmanoj322](https://github.com/skmanoj322))
- Added the `tab_switcher.show_file_preview` setting, which controls whether files are previewed in the editor while cycling through the tab switcher (defaults to `true`). ([#56235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56235); thanks [sebascadpi](https://github.com/sebascadpi))
- Improved the tab switcher so it no longer changes selection on mouse hover and no longer delays showing its popover; you can still click entries to switch tabs. ([#65546](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65546))
- Improved startup time when restoring hundreds of editor selections. ([#65171](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65171))
- Improved startup time when using custom icon themes. ([#65173](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65173))
- Reduced Zed's binary size by about 33% on macOS, 28% on Windows, and 7% on Linux. ([#65168](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65168))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where environment variables, including secrets, passed to external agents and MCP servers in remote projects were visible in the local machine's process list. ([#65174](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65174))
- Fixed prompts to external agents being slow to send, or never sending, because of unneeded Git checkpoints. ([#65304](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65304))
- Fixed the remote server failing to start when connecting to a Windows host over SSH. ([#55292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55292); thanks [sergio-u](https://github.com/sergio-u))
- Fixed `ctrl-o` and `ctrl-i` in Vim mode not navigating back and forward when a Markdown preview was focused. ([#65299](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65299); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed a bug where archiving an agent thread did nothing and kept a CPU core busy when the thread's linked worktree folder had been deleted. ([#65578](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65578))
- Fixed a bug where case conversion and other text transformation commands duplicated the word when multiple cursors were inside it. ([#65291](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65291); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed a bug where navigating back skipped a Markdown preview tab after switching to another file. ([#65299](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65299); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed a bug where notification sounds could stop playing after an audio output error, and on Linux an audio thread could keep using a full CPU core until Zed restarted. ([#65158](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65158))
- Fixed a bug where the Git Panel's commit editor buttons changed opacity when hovering over empty space. ([#65448](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65448); thanks [shuvroroy](https://github.com/shuvroroy))
- Fixed a bug where the Project Panel's "Open Markdown Preview" option did not appear for files opened on their own (e.g. `zed README.md`). ([#65539](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65539); thanks [skmanoj322](https://github.com/skmanoj322))
- Fixed a bug where the Settings UI sidebar did not highlight the subsection being scrolled through, including the last short subsections of a page. ([#65172](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65172); thanks [mayurathavale18](https://github.com/mayurathavale18))
- Fixed a visual artifact at the corners of scrollable code blocks when hovered. ([#64978](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64978))
- Fixed blurred window backgrounds not blurring on macOS 27. ([#65361](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65361); thanks [biw](https://github.com/biw))
- Fixed edit predictions showing an unlimited allowance and available controls when a team organization with no active subscription was selected. ([#65301](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65301))
- Fixed external agents' first updates in a new thread sometimes being dropped, and agent error output being missing when an agent exited during startup. ([#65339](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65339))
- Fixed extra space between the scrollbar and the header of terminals in the Agent Panel. ([#65358](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65358); thanks [chrisdrackett](https://github.com/chrisdrackett))
- Fixed Gemini models failing with an error after a tool call returned an image. ([#65576](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65576))
- Fixed hover popovers flickering or closing too early on mouse movement with language servers that omit range information. ([#64032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64032); thanks [daydalek](https://github.com/daydalek))
- Fixed images inside center- or right-aligned HTML blocks rendering left-aligned in Markdown Preview. ([#63166](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63166); thanks [pray3m](https://github.com/pray3m))
- Fixed OpenAI-compatible edit predictions failing on servers that limit stop sequences to 4. ([#65360](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65360); thanks [mischah](https://github.com/mischah))
- Fixed search not working in the debugger's terminal, opened with `cmd-f` (macOS) or `ctrl-shift-f` (Linux/Windows). ([#56863](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56863); thanks [iamsushank](https://github.com/iamsushank))
- Fixed text finder queries filled in from the current selection being treated as a regular expression instead of literal text when regex mode was on. ([#65321](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65321); thanks [Syozik](https://github.com/Syozik))
- Fixed the Collab Panel's empty-state styling not matching the Git Panel. ([#65290](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65290); thanks [arondubovszky](https://github.com/arondubovszky))
- Fixed wrapped links in Markdown tables being partially unclickable in Markdown previews and agent responses. ([#65366](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65366); thanks [julian-bruyers](https://github.com/julian-bruyers))

name: v1.24.2
body:
This week's release includes Git tag creation, the ability to drag Terminal tabs into the Agent Panel, and pre-filling of the File Finder's search query with text selected in the editor or terminal.

## Features

### AI

- Improved Agent Panel terminal support by allowing Terminal tabs to be dragged into it. ([#60582](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/60582); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Improved custom Amazon Bedrock model support with configurable tool use, images, and thinking. ([#64953](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64953); thanks [mpyuglgwkxcmodyrpo](https://github.com/mpyuglgwkxcmodyrpo))
- Improved memory and CPU usage while the agent responds in long threads. ([#65244](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65244))

### Git

- Added a `git: create tag at head` command and a `Create Tag…` context menu action in Git history and Git Graph to create local tags on commits. Tags are not pushed automatically. ([#61973](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/61973), [#65194](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65194); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added `gitiles` as a Git hosting provider for Gitiles/Gerrit deployments, enabling permalinks and navigation from the Git blame diff view. ([#63996](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63996); thanks [JonathanBerkeley](https://github.com/JonathanBerkeley))
- Added a side-by-side view for directory diffs opened with `zed --diff`. ([#64967](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64967); thanks [ian-h-chamberlain](https://github.com/ian-h-chamberlain))
- Added file counts to section headers in the Git Panel. ([#65028](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65028); thanks [mansoorkhan96](https://github.com/mansoorkhan96))
- Added self-hosted Gerrit repositories as a provider for permalinks. ([#53832](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/53832); thanks [starsep](https://github.com/starsep))
- Improved the Git Panel with a collapsible commit message editor, configurable with `git_panel.commit_editor`, and the Git Graph with collapsible commit details. ([#63236](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63236); thanks [mulhamna](https://github.com/mulhamna))
- Improved Git Graph readability by moving refs from the description column into the graph. ([#59839](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/59839); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Improved Git Panel file actions for multiple selected files. ([#64640](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64640); thanks [Acd-kk](https://github.com/Acd-kk))

### Debugger

- Improved the debugger variables view with distinct colors for values based on their type, such as integers and strings. ([#64111](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64111); thanks [syormon](https://github.com/syormon))

### Languages

- Added a `Show Source` option to the Markdown preview tab context menu. ([#65081](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65081); thanks [joshkent94](https://github.com/joshkent94))
- Added a Go package-level test gutter button next to package declarations. ([#56699](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56699); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added support for language-server extensions to configure which language servers are enabled by default in `extension.toml`. See the [extension documentation](https://zed.dev/docs/extensions/languages.md#opt-in-language-servers). ([#65030](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65030))
- Added `markdown_preview.heading_font_weight` to configure the font weight of headings in the Markdown preview. ([#64421](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64421); thanks [dremnik](https://github.com/dremnik))
- Added the `mermaid_font_family` setting to configure the font used in Mermaid diagrams. ([#63430](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63430); thanks [Sha1rholder](https://github.com/Sha1rholder))
- Improved the column filter dropdown in the tabular data preview to sort values naturally (e.g., `2` before `10`). ([#64764](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64764); thanks [HalavicH](https://github.com/HalavicH))

### Remote Development

- Improved remote server responsiveness when log or RPC response writes are blocked. ([#65011](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65011); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii))

### Linux

- Reduced the Linux release binary size by about 23% on x86_64. ([#65169](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65169))

### macOS

- Improved how Finder groups Zed on macOS by identifying it as a developer tool. ([#65130](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65130); thanks [kennyheard](https://github.com/kennyheard))

### Other

- Added an `extension_suggestions` setting to turn off extension suggestions. ([#65109](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65109); thanks [audinue](https://github.com/audinue))
- Improved the File Finder to pre-fill its query with text selected in the editor or terminal. Disable this with `file_finder.prefill_query_from_selection`. ([#64946](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64946); thanks [AbyssWaIker](https://github.com/AbyssWaIker))
- Improved multi-cursor editing performance. ([#64409](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64409); thanks [Rani367](https://github.com/Rani367))
- Improved project search speed and memory usage over misclassified binary files. ([#64549](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64549))
- Improved the Extensions view so installed extensions appear even while offline or when the remote list is incomplete. ([#64766](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64766))
- Improved the font family pickers in the settings window to render each option in its own font as a preview. ([#64199](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64199); thanks [mizanisoffline](https://github.com/mizanisoffline))
- Improved Zed startup time. ([#65170](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65170))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed `.env` files being treated as shell scripts and triggering `shellcheck` warnings. They now use the Env language. ([#64242](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64242); thanks [pleahmacaka](https://github.com/pleahmacaka))
- Fixed a crash when editing a buffer while an inlay-hint request was pending. ([#65193](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65193))
- Fixed a crash when syntax parsing requested bytes inside a multibyte character. ([#65273](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65273))
- Fixed a ty language server panic when opening a Python file as a single-file project. ([#60753](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/60753); thanks [MostlyKIGuess](https://github.com/MostlyKIGuess))
- Fixed ACP session title clearing and prevented programmatic title updates from being saved as user renames. ([#65195](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65195))
- Fixed ChatGPT Subscription models disappearing when the model catalog takes longer than 5 seconds to load. ([#64925](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64925); thanks [dualfroz](https://github.com/dualfroz))
- Fixed Command-clicking a symbol whose name matches its file name doing nothing. ([#64892](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64892); thanks [skmanoj322](https://github.com/skmanoj322))
- Fixed crashes on tab-indented code blocks. ([#65406](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65406))
- Fixed emoji, symbol, and non-Latin fonts rendering as empty boxes on Linux after being used as a font fallback. ([#65269](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65269))
- Fixed files created in a directory that was deleted and immediately recreated (for example by a build or test step that clears and repopulates an output directory) not appearing until the workspace was reloaded. ([#61372](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/61372); thanks [marcalc](https://github.com/marcalc))
- Fixed files in symlinked directories opening in a separate worktree when a language server reports them by their canonical path. ([#64895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64895); thanks [taburet](https://github.com/taburet))
- Fixed hanging during remote project search. ([#65257](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65257))
- Fixed JSON completion ordering when typing the start of a key. ([#65139](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65139); thanks [ragen1337](https://github.com/ragen1337))
- Fixed language association for `file_type` path globs with single-file worktrees. ([#60307](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/60307); thanks [notpeter](https://github.com/notpeter))
- Fixed Markdown Preview ignoring pane-split actions when focused; splitting now opens another preview in the new pane. ([#65136](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65136); thanks [yskim308](https://github.com/yskim308))
- Fixed remote paths sometimes reusing a workspace connected to a different host. ([#64145](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64145); thanks [hamishc](https://github.com/hamishc))
- Fixed selected context being lost when added before an agent thread finished loading. ([#64252](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64252); thanks [porada](https://github.com/porada))
- Fixed the Git Panel offering to initialize a repository when a single file was opened as a project, which failed with "Not a directory". ([#64948](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64948); thanks [virajbhartiya](https://github.com/virajbhartiya))

body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.4

### Highlights

- **Updates finish more reliably:** macOS updates no longer time out on aliased temporary directories, systemd user installs reclaim abandoned runtimes, pacman and FreeBSD package installs are left to their package manager, snapshot failures are identified before activation with accurate recovery advice, and the success summary no longer repeats settled plugin upgrades as pending. (#169860, #171488, #169055, #171457, #170351, #170413) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @Pegorim.
- **ChatGPT models work on the default Codex runtime:** ChatGPT-listed models no longer fail before sending any request. (#168033) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Headless browser sign-ins stay usable:** headless pages keep accepting clicks and key presses while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.

### Changes

- **Context limits:** status shows corrected context limits after model discovery, Copilot honors reported context capacity when native limits are missing, and llama.cpp keeps live router model limits and tools on refresh. (#165991, #156636, #168309) Thanks @snotty, @saju01, and @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Gateway access:** local access keeps working when the tailnet denies Tailscale Serve, and lifecycle publications survive after the emitting producer drains. (#171509, #170231) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **macOS repair and recovery:** update recovery finishes repairing the bundled Gateway, the app keeps a compatible newer Gateway during recovery instead of downgrading it, LaunchAgent repair accepts verified bootstrap recovery, and Doctor allows offline state repair for app-owned Gateways. (#171508, #170766, #170740, #170768) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update resilience:** updates keep moving when optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup fails. (#170754) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Security:** Tlon never treats group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Turns and replies:** Claude CLI sessions remember announced sub-agent results on the next turn, agent plugin reloads no longer wait on their own turn, interrupted turns are preserved when new messages arrive, ACP follow-up replies no longer disappear after the previous turn is stopped, context-engine advancement survives steering, visible sub-agent spawns try the primary model first, and launched agent turns no longer fail with writer claim errors. (#164175, #171257, #170647, #170883, #168394, #169984, #170077) Thanks @robertoronderosjr, @RomneyDa, @etzelm, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** the Gateway stays responsive during reply-tagged streams and long quoted tool XML no longer triggers per-token Markdown parsing, blocked context-engine turns stop repeating in the Gateway log on every run, the Control UI no longer reconnects on delayed heartbeats, state reads stay closed until restart after a failed state cleanup, the Gateway recovers state ownership after sleep and clock changes, stalled transcript workers no longer block shutdown, database admission no longer blocks worker startup, shutdown joins lifecycle publication, forced descendant cleanup releases worker capacity, enabled standalone plugin files start with the Gateway, Gateway restart works from verified external macOS terminals, and Android/Termux gateways no longer fail with "shared-state database generation changed". (#166782, #171573, #167595, #171253, #171709, #170790, #170493, #170348, #170555, #168746, #171330, #170354, #167719) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @holgergruenhagen, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @yxshee, @grabowskidaniel359-design, @jjjhenriksen, @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, @Oldrich333, @residentb2b, @boeingchoco, and @jalehman.
- **Workers:** worker heap limits are enforced under process-wide Node flags. (#166581) Thanks @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, and @waynegault.
- **Channels and tools:** MCP OAuth login completes with portless loopback registrations, and each Feishu monitor start gets its own binding adapter registration. (#170876, #169226) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art, @ruel225, @obviyus, and @junniar.
- **Update and Doctor:** update repair no longer fails after Doctor completes on busy macOS hosts, slow update admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, update repair prepares its config before inference, metadata inventory survives progress-output backpressure, Docker upgrades stop retry loops on older Linux hosts, Doctor explains plugin migration backup coverage, and Doctor no longer logs spurious WAL maintenance warnings while repairing shared state. (#170779, #171493, #170276, #168493, #162305, #169295, #170783) Thanks @vincentkoc, @yxshee, @Ludwigtheo0815, @RomneyDa, and @DonnieFi.
- **Plugin publishing:** plugin npm publication no longer fails when artifact pagination repeats an entry. (#171044) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.3..9e0a1c922e978fbcfb14c29d112573f6a99468d7 history: 61 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 61 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: openclaw 2026.9.33
body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.3)

## 2026.9.33

### Highlights

- **Safer September upgrades:** updates on the 2026.9 line keep state, plugin data, service ownership, and Windows state paths intact, and refuse automatic restore over unattributed Doctor writes. (#160167, #166755) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @Alix-007, @jayzhou2309, @nitinjwadhawan, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @taihartman, and @DonnieFi.
- **Updates that finish on pnpm, npm, and Windows:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and launchers survive native updates, retained updater runtimes no longer block npm recovery, and Windows updates no longer roll back after Doctor rechecks driver ancestry. (#170003, #170131, #170170, #169563) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **New model support:** run Meta Muse Wonder, use MiniMax M3.1 thinking effort levels, and stay signed in to MiniMax portal OAuth past token expiry. (#170232, #160089, #160459) Thanks @RomneyDa, @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, @rongtianhua, @DonnieFi, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **More reliable model turns:** agent runs honor live thinking levels, local providers get response-header deadlines, ChatGPT WebSocket normal closes recover, and Codex replies keep their final tokens. (#168566, #168282, #167512, #168400) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @ajmtrz.
- **Work survives Gateway restarts:** interrupted automation turns, steered sessions, cloud worker claims, and partial worker replies now resume or persist after a restart. (#170162, #170252, #170161, #170223) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Delivery and device stability:** live sends survive queue recovery, and node requests no longer fail on unrelated pairing activity or while another device's pairing is written. (#169010, #169486, #169575) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Agent and update stability:** carry a broad batch of compatible October fixes for agent turns, sessions, channels, and update recovery. (#170476) Thanks @RomneyDa, @yetval, @Dimitri-lcht, @Program-123, @dhruv1220, @Shenrui-Ma, @igs-rogenlo, @changeroa, @hxy91819, @Takhoffman, @harjothkhara, @TYY-2005, @giodl73-repo, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jalehman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @an2in.

### Changes

- **Meta:** add the Muse Wonder model to the catalog and onboarding with max thinking support, keeping Spark as the default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **MiniMax:** add the MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview model and route its thinking effort levels to the provider. (#160089) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **LM Studio:** refreshing saved inventory now discovers newly loaded models. (#168039) Thanks @jb-lopez, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Fixes

- **Update and Doctor:** keep Doctor running under unreadable supervisors and child binding errors, keep clean service install refusals out of native-authority recovery, stop update history writes from stalling cron and cleanup, avoid bookkeeping-only repair refusals, and never delete an OAuth profile because the legacy auth store is unreadable. (#169665, #169658, #169283, #170195, #170256) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Yolo521-bot, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Updating from 2026.8.35:** cron jobs approved with "allow always" keep running unattended after the update, pnpm 12 Gateway services left on a deleted store generation are rewritten to the durable install link, Doctor defers optional checks so updates finish under older updaters' time limits, official plugins with removed SDK imports are no longer silently kept, and Kubernetes pods run Doctor before starting. (#171816) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** long streamed replies that start with a reply tag such as `[[reply_to_current]]` no longer re-parse the whole reply on every delta, which could keep the Gateway busy for tens of seconds. #166781 (#166782) Thanks @boeingchoco and @obviyus.
- **Tailscale:** an interrupted Tailscale Serve start stops its serve process, the Gateway keeps local access when the tailnet denies Serve, and public chat no longer returns 503s right after startup. #167436 (#167514, #171509, #167604) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- **Context engine:** sessions holding an old blocked turn no longer repeat the blocked-turn warning and re-read it on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- **State database:** state reads no longer stay closed until a Gateway restart after a failed state cleanup. Fixes #162085. (#171709) Thanks @RomneyDa and @residentb2b.
- **Update summaries and Doctor:** successful updates stop listing settled plugin data and settings upgrades as pending, optional dreaming-cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer block updates, and macOS LaunchAgent repair accepts an in-progress bootstrap. (#170413, #170754, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa and @DonnieFi.
- **Providers:** recover DeepSeek `calls` markup instead of leaking tool payloads, recover Codex follow-up requests after failed thread preparation, and select aliased llama.cpp models while failing setup when credentials cannot be saved. (#169728, #169431, #168232) Thanks @TOMUIV, @jjjhenriksen, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Channels and tools:** channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account, ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed separately, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and routed turns deliver blocking questions. (#164848, #159396, #164272, #170083, #170039) Thanks @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @ajmtrz, @brokemac79, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @mightyx.
- **Automation:** failed one-shot automations always alert, and cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on host admission. (#169102, #168291) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Release checks:** Windows installer checks tolerate slow `gateway stop` help and surface cleanup errors, packaged checks recover from a busy Gateway port, and extended-stable candidates now qualify upgrades from the previous extended-stable release. (#169567, #170178, #171565) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.9.9..a902bd2d4bd1707cdc0c861bb9bf92727645f700 history: 65 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 65 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: v2.11.30 — Lessons from Railway's agent-first growth, Wispr Flow's creator ad program, and recent h…
body:
Lessons from Railway's agent-first growth, Wispr Flow's creator ad program, and recent hook and X-listening threads, added to existing skills.

- **ai-seo** (2.7.6 → 2.8.0): `references/agent-defaults.md` covers products an agent installs mid-task. It explains how to measure which vendor Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex pick per stack, which stall points to fix, and the levers that move the default (no-signup provisioning, agent setup, per-stack task pages, migration guides). It also rules out agent-facing instructions that tell agents to choose you.
- **influencer-marketing** (1.2.0 → 1.3.0): `references/paid-ads-creator-program.md` covers creators paid a share of the ad spend behind their videos. It includes rate math, the guaranteed monthly minimum, recruiting a small cohort, staged growth with a cap, coaching, and four-part briefs.
- **ads** (2.4.7 → 2.5.0): the Meta playbook adds creator ads at volume. Near-identical ads get clustered, so plan by concept, angle, and awareness level, optimize for a quality event, and test the funnel in Instagram's in-app browser. AI variant farming now notes that close variants count as one concept. LinkedIn retargeting is now sequenced by behavior.
- **ad-creative** (2.11.0 → 2.12.0): the hook system adds the contrast family (choice, old vs. new, us vs. them, false assumption, declaration then question) and how it differs from the "it's not X, it's Y" AI tell.
- **social** (2.3.4 → 2.4.0): contrast hooks in the short-form library, and X-through-Grok jobs in the listening reference.
- **marketing-loops** (1.4.0 → 1.5.0): agent-default check, niche-outlier, creator-scouting, and launch-reaction loops. The catalog now has 56 loops.

Complete source catalog: 50 skills.
Claude web target: 50 skills with reviewed short descriptions.

Choose `<name>-claude-web.zip` for the documented single-folder web upload format.
Source ZIPs retain original metadata; they are not substitutes for omitted web ZIPs.
Live client upload, account limits, and invocation behavior have not been verified.

name: v1.9.0
body:
## Upgrade notice: Shopify migration required

**v1.9.0 includes breaking changes for Shopify integrations. Review existing Shopify workflows before upgrading.**

- The `shopify_admin` provider has been removed and consolidated into `shopify`. Update service references and configure a connection under `shopify`; there is no compatibility alias for the old service name.
- For API-key connections, use the Shopify Admin API access token and the `shopDomain` field (for example, `acme.myshopify.com`). OAuth client configuration uses `shopSubdomain` (for example, `acme`). Check that the connection has the scopes required by the actions you use.
- Re-read each action's input and output schemas before migrating. GraphQL actions use string global IDs such as `gid://shopify/Product/123`, cursor inputs such as `first` and `after`, and `pageInfo` pagination metadata. The `get_shop` action now returns normalized GraphQL shop fields, so existing REST response field mappings need updating.
- REST content actions for blogs, pages, and articles retain numeric IDs and `limit` / `page_info` pagination. Apply the schema for the specific action rather than converting every Shopify action to GraphQL parameters.

See [Shopify consolidation and expanded actions](https://github.com/oomol-lab/open-connector/pull/718) and the [current Shopify action definitions](https://github.com/oomol-lab/open-connector/tree/v1.9.0/src/providers/shopify).

## Highlights

- Added 53 provider definitions since v1.8.0, including QuickBooks Online, LiteLLM, GreyNoise, Opper, ScanMalware, Kagi, and API Route.
- Expanded existing integrations, including Gmail attachments and CID inline images, Shopify Admin operations, WhatsApp analytics, and Feishu workflows.
- Improved OAuth reconnect reporting, refresh lifetime handling, and protection against concurrent disconnects; added optional consent scopes, optional token revocation, and a configurable completion-page close delay.
- Moved downloads across many providers to streaming transit storage and fixed transit cleanup, multipart byte limits, and malformed Unicode filenames.
- Improved runtime error envelopes, generated action examples, provider error handling, and dependency security fixes.

name: v0.2.1-alpha.4
body:
[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

## 中文

### 新增功能

- 自定义模型 API 支持通过UI中配置各模型的推理等级，无需手动修改配置文件。 by @LegGasai
- 允许用户从“自定义插件索引源”中发现和安装插件。 by @turtle1999 

### 问题修复

- 修复命令与参数交界处输入异常的问题。支持整体选中/删除，并在撤销或刷新页面后恢复。 by @LegGasai
- 改进 Office 文件交付：避免在回复中引用已删除的预览图，减少 PDF 导出后不必要的工具查找和额外检查。 by @yudshj
- 修复启用开发者工具后，仍需刷新页面才能打开工具面板的问题。 by @imccyu
- 减少 Linux 下启动命令前的重复检查，降低命令启动开销，并改善较旧 systemd 环境的兼容性。 by @imccyu
- 修复命令执行失败时，未呈现有效的状态信息。 by @yudshj

### 其他变更

- 第三方插件的版本兼容性优先按 `engines.dsh` 判断；未声明时沿用原有规则。插件作者需检查声明是否覆盖支持的 DSH 版本。 by @turtle1999

---

## English

### New Features

- Configure reasoning levels for individual custom API models in the UI without editing configuration files manually. by @LegGasai
- Discover and install plugins from custom plugin index sources. by @turtle1999

### Bug Fixes

- Fix input glitches between a command and its arguments. Commands can be selected and deleted as a whole, and restored after undo or a page reload. by @LegGasai
- Improve Office file delivery: avoid referencing deleted preview images in replies and reduce unnecessary tool searches and extra checks after PDF export. by @yudshj
- Fix Developer Tools requiring a page reload before its panel can open after being enabled. by @imccyu
- Reduce repeated checks before launching commands on Linux, lowering startup overhead and improving compatibility with older systemd environments. by @imccyu
- Fix failed commands not displaying useful status information. by @yudshj

### Other Changes

- Third-party plugin compatibility prioritizes `engines.dsh` when declared and otherwise uses the existing rules. Plugin authors should check that the declared range covers their supported DSH versions. by @turtle1999

name: v0.98.1
body:
**Faster idle sessions and richer responses**

### Highlights

- Reduce idle CPU and disk reads in repositories with many untracked files
- Share model catalog processing across equivalent clients while keeping usage and account state fresh
- Allow Desktop-capable clients to receive Markdown responses through the new user_response tool

### Improvements

- Show compact context usage before and after compaction
- Open the resume picker immediately while session scanning continues in the background
- Disable automatic memory recall while retaining explicit memory search
- Display large recorded token and cost summaries compactly

### Fixes

- Recover browser handoffs from runtime provider failures using direct browser actions
- Restore Windows companion connections over named pipes
- Expose global user-session connection presence to SDK clients
- Keep worker emoji placement consistent in the swarm status strip

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.97.0...v0.98.1

## What's Changed
### 🚨 Security
* Improve MCP startup compatibility and lazy-load CLI commands by @Shockang in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/207
* test: add integration test coverage and fix KuzuDB fork crashes by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/209
### 🚀 Features

Eight community pull requests: a Windows MCP-stdio hang fix, Rust/JS/TS/extract call-resolution and id-collision fixes, an Ollama context-size fix, and a clustering label-retention fix. The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.

- Fix: **MCP** `graph_stats` no longer hangs under a stdio host on Windows (and no longer silently drops its built-at-commit staleness line): `_git_head` closes the git child's stdin so git does not block on the JSON-RPC pipe (#4440, #4441, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: **Rust** a `use crate::…::Name` edge now lands on the declaration it imports rather than a bare name-folded target (#4439, #4443, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: **JS/TS** a file-scope callback's own parameters are now shadowed, so a bare parameter passed on as a call argument no longer mints phantom cross-bundle `indirect_call` edges (#4448, #4457, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: **extract** a module symbol whose id spells a sibling file's id (a `const sql` beside `x.sql`) is kept on its own node instead of being merged onto the sibling's file node and dropped (#4449, #4452, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **TypeScript** a class field's receiver type is now scoped to its own class and bases, so `this.field.method()` resolves to the right class when two classes share a field name (#4294, #4297, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **Ollama** extraction and labeling requests now go to Ollama's native `/api/chat`, so the derived `num_ctx` actually reaches the server and large prompts are no longer silently truncated; a server without `/api/chat` falls back to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (#4413, #4414, thanks @smngvlkz).
- Fix: **cluster** a community keeps its curated or LLM label across a rebuild when its membership still overlaps the previous community by a strict majority (#2298, #4451, thanks @SrijanSriv).
- Test: **ingest** the skip-existing symlink test now compares the link target against what `readlink` returned, fixing a false failure on Windows (#4435, #4442, thanks @bercedev).
