## [2.12.4] ### Enhancements - [`5d1e8777a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/5d1e8777a04dfee9eb4e5ef4eb4664c8914ef79c) ([#16286](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16286)) Improve the error message on iOS when the development server cannot be reached through a `localhost` URL, suggesting `tauri ios dev --host`. ### Bug Fixes - [`9c3fb8865`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/9c3fb8865fcc33982dff31c821d988a9a038ff8c) ([#16197](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16197)) Fix a panic in the IPC and asset protocol handlers when the request URI has an empty path (for example `ipc:foo`). - [`7b673ddaa`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/7b673ddaaf885ecaecfe79dfeb4cac1c6880fce6) ([#16146](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16146)) `PluginHandle::run_mobile_plugin_async` and `PluginHandle::run_mobile_plugin` no longer panic (which aborts the process on iOS and Android) when a mobile plugin command resolves after its caller stopped waiting, for example when the async call was cancelled by a timeout. The late response is dropped instead. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-build@2.7.3` - Upgraded to `tauri-utils@2.10.2` - Upgraded to `tauri-runtime@2.12.2` - Upgraded to `tauri-runtime-wry@2.12.2` - Upgraded to `tauri-macros@2.7.3`

## [3.0.0-alpha.6] ### New Features - [`a7b81d993`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/a7b81d993da706e5c94b64cecb91815b517627b3) ([#16225](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16225) by [@mayocream](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../mayocream)) Allow CEF windowless browsers with an application-provided render handler and native window event callback. Applications provide painting, input, IME, cursor handling and composition. ### Bug Fixes - [`d78cc6085`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/d78cc6085b9ab8a036d4e6430d1f20e9c0cf1889) ([#16241](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16241) by [@beanow-at-crabnebula](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../beanow-at-crabnebula)) Fixed CEF child processes ignoring `Cef::cef_api_version`. Renderer, GPU and utility processes now declare the same CEF API version as the browser process, which passes it on each child's command line as `--tauri-cef-api-version=`. - [`6a2cb9688`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/6a2cb9688b7d28daf7c76b9beffc872477164a72) Fixed the app reopening hidden copies of its previous run's windows, which kept the process alive after every app window was closed. After a crash or a kill, Chromium's session restore reopened the last session's tabs in Chrome browser windows the runtime does not own. The runtime now sets the `session.restore_on_startup` profile preference to open the New Tab page, which restores nothing. `Cef::profile_preference_value` can still override it. - [`c6b974b8a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/c6b974b8acd0083b35dce37a2d3792ed95cb85c6) ([#16275](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16275) by [@github-actions](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../github-actions)) Fix overlay titlebars intercepting webview mouse events on macOS. - [`a5e3a697e`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/a5e3a697e48f50273982dca658e90402cd977a9f) ([#16240](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16240) by [@beanow-at-crabnebula](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../beanow-at-crabnebula)) Report an unsupported CEF API version instead of crashing. The runtime now checks the result of `cef_api_hash`: the browser process logs the version and fails with `Error::WebviewRuntimeNotInstalled`, and a helper process panics with the same message. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-utils@3.0.0-alpha.4` - Upgraded to `tauri-runtime@3.0.0-alpha.4` - Upgraded to `tauri-macros@3.0.0-alpha.4` - Upgraded to `tauri@3.0.0-alpha.5` - [`370ea9769`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/370ea97696ae280db894a81aea97e917f293e6db) Bump CEF to 154.5.0+154.0.34.

The certificate format is now detected and passed to `security import` explicitly (PKCS#12 or a PEM bundle), and import failures explain the expected certificate format and password. ### Dependencies - [`5a3cbfcdc`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/5a3cbfcdcaad82185ce2cc9f4d246c78e144c78c) ([#16279](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16279)) **Breaking Change:** Temporarily inlined the code we need from apple-codesign-rs until its next release to unblock important dependency updates. Technically this is a breaking change to the `CertificateProfile` enum re-export and the `Error::FailedToCreateSelfSignedCertificate` enum variant.

## [2.12.3] ### Enhancements - [`107f93ae0`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/107f93ae0b8bbcd3eec4f8af848034272a67b849) ([#16259](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16259)) Standalone Linux ARM64 GNU and musl CLI archives are now included in releases. ### Bug Fixes - [`c95be4615`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/c95be4615a432b1d12409d3684c960e8aa718ada) ([#16287](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16287)) Fix `tauri ios xcode-script` failing to find the Tauri project when Xcode inherits package manager environment variables from `tauri ios dev --open`, or when pnpm runs the CLI directly from the `gen/apple` folder. - [`d62e5d9c0`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/d62e5d9c0878b6fb327543cc9be50aa1696ee23c) ([#16184](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16184)) Fix NSIS installer leaving `uninstall.exe` and the installation directory behind when uninstalling an existing installation from the installer. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-utils@2.10.2` - Upgraded to `tauri-macos-sign@2.4.2` - Upgraded to `tauri-bundler@2.10.3` - [`5a2953e55`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/5a2953e555b4444bed68bd5324ea13ad85a6c06e) ([#16237](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16237)) Updated NSIS to 3.13

## [3.0.0-alpha.4] ### New Features - [`7cf5d9032`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/7cf5d903221d1400c0d256cbbff3a46d2d55781e) ([#16198](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16198) by [@Vishal-770](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../Vishal-770)) Add `bundle > linux > deb > compression` config option to control Debian bundle compression type and level. - [`0e849336a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/0e849336a7f2b406d2d508cbdd01a25bcb02f8b9) ([#16261](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16261) by [@github-actions](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../github-actions)) zstd compression for deb and rpm bundles accepts negative levels (down to -131072) for zstd's fast modes. `DebCompression::Zstd`'s `level` is now an `i32`, and `DebCompression::{default_level, min_level, max_level, level}` return `Option`. ### Bug Fixes - [`a5e3a697e`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/a5e3a697e48f50273982dca658e90402cd977a9f) ([#16240](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16240) by [@beanow-at-crabnebula](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../beanow-at-crabnebula)) Report an unsupported CEF API version instead of crashing. The runtime now checks the result of `cef_api_hash`: the browser process logs the version and fails with `Error::WebviewRuntimeNotInstalled`, and a helper process panics with the same message. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-utils@3.0.0-alpha.4` - Upgraded to `tauri-macos-sign@3.0.0-alpha.3` ### Breaking Changes - [`0e849336a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/0e849336a7f2b406d2d508cbdd01a25bcb02f8b9) ([#16261](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16261) by [@github-actions](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../github-actions)) RPM bundles are compressed with zstd level 19 instead of gzip level 6 when `bundle > linux > rpm > compression` is not set, which matches rpm's own default. zstd payloads need rpm 4.14 or newer, so set the option to gzip to keep installing on older distributions.

## [2.10.3] ### Bug Fixes - [`5a6149898`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/5a614989840d3176775cbdb8731ab7ca328845e2) ([#16227](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16227)) `output_ok` used to throw away the stderr it captured, so a failing bundler script surfaced as a bare "failed to run" with no diagnosis (#3055). The stderr (or stdout, for tools such as WiX and signtool that report errors there) is now part of the error, and when the DMG script dies because macOS denied the terminal permission to control Finder, the error says where to enable it: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation. - [`d62e5d9c0`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/d62e5d9c0878b6fb327543cc9be50aa1696ee23c) ([#16184](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16184)) Fix NSIS installer leaving `uninstall.exe` and the installation directory behind when uninstalling an existing installation from the installer. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-utils@2.10.2` - Upgraded to `tauri-macos-sign@2.4.2` - [`5a2953e55`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/5a2953e555b4444bed68bd5324ea13ad85a6c06e) ([#16237](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16237)) Updated NSIS to 3.13 - [`55883af3f`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/55883af3f40b569d57ff9ae4bfc0b1db5845a7d9) ([#15639](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/15639)) Updated `rpm-rs` crate to `v0.30` which should improve build times for .rpm bundles.

body:
## [3.0.0-alpha.5]

### New Features

- [`7cf5d9032`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/7cf5d903221d1400c0d256cbbff3a46d2d55781e) ([#16198](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16198) by [@Vishal-770](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../Vishal-770)) Add `bundle > linux > deb > compression` config option to control Debian bundle compression type and level.
- [`0e849336a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/0e849336a7f2b406d2d508cbdd01a25bcb02f8b9) ([#16261](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16261) by [@github-actions](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../github-actions)) zstd compression for deb and rpm bundles accepts negative levels (down to -131072) for zstd's fast modes. `DebCompression::Zstd`'s `level` is now an `i32`, and `DebCompression::{default_level, min_level, max_level, level}` return `Option<i32>`.

### Dependencies

- Upgraded to `tauri-cli@3.0.0-alpha.5`

### Breaking Changes

- [`0e849336a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/0e849336a7f2b406d2d508cbdd01a25bcb02f8b9) ([#16261](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16261) by [@github-actions](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../github-actions)) RPM bundles are compressed with zstd level 19 instead of gzip level 6 when `bundle > linux > rpm > compression` is not set, which matches rpm's own default. zstd payloads need rpm 4.14 or newer, so set the option to gzip to keep installing on older distributions.

name: Cua Spaces v0.9.0
body:
# Cua Spaces 0.9.0

## Highlights

- **The New UI is on by default.** The redesigned app (the same UI as the new Windows and Linux app) opens by default. You can switch back any time: Settings → Experiments → Use classic UI.
- **A real Teams screen.** Settings → Teams lists your organizations, their members and pending invites. Manage team and Billing open the account app at app.cua.ai. The app now talks to api.cua.ai and app.cua.ai, and no longer calls the retired run.cua.ai.
- **Drop onto a Space.** Drag a window onto a Space's tile to teleport it there, or drop files on a tile to send them to that Space.
- **Find things faster.** A filter box on the Spaces page. ⌘K finds machines by name and keyword. Power errors now show on the Space's tile.

## Fixes

- The Get started checklist shows the same count in every UI, and the Machines page lists every machine.
- Teleport: clearer words when a teleport is refused, the right title after Back, and the right Status for a Space that can't be reached.
- Windows: sign-in, Docker detection, presence without Windows Hello, teleporting Edge, and wording fixes.
- Linux: the Ubuntu .deb can be removed cleanly, onboarding images show, the skipped sign-in panel is fixed, and the Chrome sandbox works.
- The Windows and Linux app ships on stable releases.

## Full changelog

[cua-spaces-v0.8.0...cua-spaces-v0.9.0](https://github.com/trycua/cua/compare/cua-spaces-v0.8.0...cua-spaces-v0.9.0) · [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/main/apps/cua-spaces-macos/CHANGELOG.md)

name: v0.8.0-alpha.2
body:
## Highlights

- **New template and rendering internals** (#5554):
  - Dioxus no longer uses comment-node placeholders and markers, either at runtime or during hydration. Elements that treat their children as text, such as `textarea`, now render correctly.
  - `rsx!` now expands to a const builder API, which you can also use directly.
  - HTML elements are trait-based, and you can define your own with `dioxus::html::define_elements!`.
  - Core now supports renderer IDs. These lay the groundwork for portals and multiple windows sharing one runtime.
- **Dioxus Native** is updated to Blitz `0.3.0-beta.3` (#5780, #5909). This release also fixes a leak where removed nodes were never freed (#5911). A falsy boolean attribute like `disabled: false` is now removed instead of being written as `"false"` (#5913). Attributes now default to the empty namespace (#5851).
- **Linux desktop apps no longer link `libxdo` by default** (#5749). This fixes prebuilt binaries failing to start on distros that ship a different `libxdo` soname.
- **CLI:**
  - The bundle application name now comes from `application.name` in `Dioxus.toml` (#5533).
  - The runtime no-downloads setting is now respected when bundling (#5748).
  - Fixed a wasm-opt `SIGABRT` when stripping binaries (#5736).
  - Fixed wasm hot-patching with wasm-bindgen 0.2.128 and newer (#5843).
  - The dev server proxy now sets `X-Forwarded-Host` (#5627).

## Breaking changes

- **HTML elements are no longer namespaced under `dioxus_elements`** (#5554). Because element builders are now ordinary items, they can clash with other names in scope. For example, write `html::main {}` instead of `main {}` when your crate also has a `main` function.
- **`libxdo` is now opt-in on Linux** (#5749). If your app uses the predefined Copy, Cut, Paste or Select All menu items, enable the `linux-libxdo` feature on `dioxus-desktop`. That means adding `dioxus-desktop` to your dependencies directly, because the feature isn't exposed through `dioxus`.

## What's Changed
* Lock cargo-msrv installation dependencies in CI by @danielkov in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5728
* Remove CODEOWNERS by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5727
* Fix leak in manganis iOS FFI wrappers: hold Retained<AnyObject> instead of a raw pointer by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5733
* feat(cli): Set bundle application name from config by @adamgreg in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5533
* feat(desktop): make libxdo opt-in on Linux via `linux-libxdo` by @nabbisen in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5749
* fix(bundle): honor runtime no-downloads setting by @subotac in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5748
* Fix manganis-macro resolve_missing_file_path test on Windows by @jkelleyrtp in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5762
* Markerless placeholders/Portals/Multiwindow/const builder/optimized templates by @ealmloff in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5554
* Upgrade to Blitz 0.3.0-beta.2 by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5780
* Skip stable fragment edge scans when no children need placement by @ealmloff in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5802
* Set X-Forwarded-Host in the proxy by @paholg in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5627
* fix(rsx): `quote_spanned!` -> `quote!`. Resolves clippy::useless_format lints. by @scottfones in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5636
* Fix windows-hotpatch-fullstack flake: route LaunchedRoot through Subsecond; remove SymbolData probe log spam by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5790
* cli: mirror Cargo's implicit strip default when manually stripping binaries (fixes wasm-opt SIGABRT) by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5736
* lychee: exclude freyaui.dev (403 from bot protection) by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5844
* fix(liveview): don't double the `?` and `#` when reading the browser location by @Dev-next-gen in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5836
* Use the empty namespace by default on HTML attributes by @hovinen in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5851
* Introduce a function to create a synthetic form event by @hovinen in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5750
* ci: fix Linux apt package install (stale apt lists + poisoned cache), fix `cargo msrv find` by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5873
* fix(router-macro): omit `?` and stray `&` when query arguments are empty by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5845
* cli: fix wasm hot-patch fat builds with wasm-bindgen 0.2.128 / Rust beta (Playwright CI) by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5843
* fix: Filter crates that are not in target by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5903
* Eliminate `quote`/`proc-macro2` deps from `dioxus-config-macro` crate by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5868
* Sync Dioxus Native (Blitz 0.3.0-beta.3) by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5909
* Drop nodes removed by Dioxus in dioxus-native-dom by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5911
* Remove unused attributes.rs from core-types by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5910
* Playwright: don't walk hot-patch temp `target` dirs during test collection by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5914
* fix(native): remove falsy boolean attributes instead of writing "false" by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5913 (originally #5846 by @ethanstoner)

## New Contributors
* @adamgreg made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5533
* @nabbisen made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5749
* @subotac made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5748
* @paholg made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5627
* @scottfones made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5636
* @Dev-next-gen made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5836

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/compare/v0.8.0-alpha.1...v0.8.0-alpha.2
